  Problem: If `${N_HEAD}` is empty or `null` (e.g., GraphQL extraction yields no value for an unusual PR shape), the glob `== auto/...` evaluates to false and the PR is not skipped — this is the safe default. However, the earlier `[[ "${N_BASE}" == orchestrator/project-* ]] || [[ "${N_HEAD}" == orchestrator/project-* ]]` guard at ~16602 has the same pattern-match-on-maybe-null exposure upstream of the new guard.
  Why it fails at runtime: No runtime failure; an empty `${N_HEAD}` simply passes through this skip and proceeds to the comments-scan and force-merge path. This advisory flag is filed for completeness only — the safe default is "don't skip" rather than "over-skip".
